programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel and O want to put on a magic show for Mom and X the Owl, but the grownups are busy with their book club. Daniel and O perform their show for their puppet audience instead!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: At the touch of a button, bizarre things are appearing in The Makery. These inspire today's makes: a bird in a hat, frozen yoghurt monster bark, and a bull costume.

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Alex and Abi learn about reusing, recycling and repurposing using Maurice's Marvellous Recycling Machine! Professor Veena Sahajwalla visits to talk about her invention, green steel. Through The Windows we meet some koalas!

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.sub_title: I Like To Eat Apple And Bananas
programs.desc: Tsehay and John are in the Wiggly Kitchen doing some meal prep for a post work out meal and they find an apple and Banana, what could they make? Sing and dance along to the classic 'Apples and Bananas'.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends
programs.desc: When Thomas has a run of bad luck, he tries everything to get back on track... even if it means following Lorenzo's strange, superstitious advice!

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy and her friends Melanie and Grunty have a music lesson today with Aunt Alice. Miffy is so happy that she can't wait to play the instrument she has chosen as much as possible: The Shining Triangle.
